label: Sample journey — Sam Rivera (fictional)
note: Stages and checkpoints come from information supplied by the user and the dental team. Nothing here is a clinical timeline; completion describes recorded activity only. Fictional sample.

stages.title: Starting point
stages.purpose: Add insurance documents, select a preset plan, and add the dentist's treatment plan.

checkpoints.label: Plan document added
checkpoints.detail: Harborview Dental PPO 2026 (fictional demonstration plan) selected from the preset catalog. Rules are read from the stored document with page citations.

checkpoints.label: Treatment plan added
checkpoints.detail: Estimate from Northside Dental Group (fictional), dated 2026-10-03: porcelain/ceramic crown on tooth 30 ($1,200) and a two-surface posterior composite on tooth 19 ($300). Typed by the user; planned dates come from the estimate.

checkpoints.label: Benefit statement entered
checkpoints.detail: Figures from a benefit statement dated 2026-09-15, entered by the user: deductible $50 met (applied 2026-05-22); plan paid $745 so far this year. Remaining annual maximum is derived: $1,500 − $745 = $755. These figures are not in the plan document.

source.label: Benefit statement figures entered by the user

stages.title: Before your visit
stages.purpose: Review appointment information, projected costs, and any preparation instructions supplied by the dental team.

checkpoints.label: Cost estimate reviewed
checkpoints.detail: Projected costs for the two planned procedures under the Harborview rules, with every amount traceable to a clause.

checkpoints.label: Appointment information recorded
checkpoints.detail: No appointment date has been recorded. The estimate lists planned completion dates (composite 2026-10-20; crown preparation 2026-11-03, completion 2026-11-20) — these are planning dates from the estimate, not confirmed appointments.

checkpoints.label: Preparation instructions viewed
checkpoints.detail: No preparation instructions have been supplied by the dental team. OralCompass does not generate instructions.

stages.title: Your appointment
stages.purpose: Record the visit and organize the treatment information and documents received.

checkpoints.label: Appointment recorded
checkpoints.detail: Record the date of the visit and which procedures were performed, as stated by the dental team.

checkpoints.label: Documents received organized
checkpoints.detail: Receipts, treatment notes and any pre-treatment estimate response from the plan can be stored here.

stages.title: Recovery
stages.purpose: View the dental team's recovery instructions and track milestones you record or that the dental team confirms.

checkpoints.label: Aftercare instructions viewed
checkpoints.detail: No aftercare instructions have been supplied by the dental team yet. When added, they are shown as written, with their source.

checkpoints.label: Recovery milestone recorded
checkpoints.detail: Milestones you mark are labeled as user-marked. Milestones confirmed by the dental team are labeled as confirmed, with the date they gave. Checklist completion is not a statement about healing.

stages.title: Follow-up
stages.purpose: Organize follow-up appointments, questions, records, and updated cost information.

checkpoints.label: Follow-up appointment scheduled
checkpoints.detail: No follow-up date has been recorded.

checkpoints.label: Updated cost information reviewed
checkpoints.detail: After the plan processes a claim, the Explanation of Benefits can be entered here to compare the projected and actual amounts.
